candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0 across all three checkout traces, so checkout requests time out at the gateway and return 502.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show postgres save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0, followed by order ReadTimeout and gateway 502s; gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. This bounds the fault to order's postgres dependency, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion. Redis and payment calls returned 200, arguing against redis-timeout and downstream-latency.
